operation.name: GetGBVImportedFile
operation.query: SELECT [ImportedID] ,[CreationTimestamp] ,[UserID] ,[SourceFilename] ,[UploadedFile] ,[DestinationFilename] ,[GBVType] ,[GBVImported] FROM [GBVImportedFiles] WHERE DELETED = 0 AND ImportedID = @id

operation.name: CheckGBVImportedFile
operation.query: Set @returnValue = (select top 1 ImportedID from GBVImportedFiles WHERE GBVImported = 1 and HASHBYTES('MD5', UploadedFile) = HASHBYTES('MD5', @UploadedFile) )

operation.name: UpdateStatusGBVImportedFile
